opening.argument: The video presents a straightforward $25 Fandango gift-card giveaway: viewers who commented by the stated deadline were entered, the comments were gathered for selection, and RANDOM.ORG was used to choose among them. The announced recipient was asked to email an address for mailing, but the available evidence identifies no fee, address misuse, or deceptive conduct connected to that step. The description also disclaims any YouTube affiliation and refers to terms. Those terms are not included here, and there is no evidence of the eventual delivery outcome, so the record supports an ordinary promotional reward without establishing more than that.

citations.quote: Anybody who commented by December 5th, you are in there.

absolutely no affiliation. With YouTube whatsoever.
